title: Arabidopsis exploration-atmosphere omics: curated metadata catalog and feasibility audit
description: Version 0.1.0 public metadata catalog and feasibility audit for Arabidopsis low-pressure and oxygen-related omics, treated single-nucleus comparators and reference-atlas suitability. Original documentation and catalog annotations: CC BY 4.0. Supporting original Python software: MIT (explicit code exception; see LICENSE). Third-party records and underlying data retain source rights. Includes factual metadata extracts, CSV inventories, reports, code, tests and reproducibility instructions; no biological measurement files. No exact nominal NASA-mixture dataset is verified within searched coverage. This file does not upload, publish or reserve a DOI.
